verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents GitHub integration and agent workflows that open pull requests with fixes or remediations, and that review PRs with label-triggered comments. The step of connecting a repository (auth or repo selection) is only implied by a 'Git integrations' line item, with no documented setup flow. Missing for 10: documented GitHub repo connection/authorization flow, explicit description of repo code access setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect a GitHub repository so an agent can access the code and open pull requests against it

citations.quote: Detect failed workflows, inspect logs, identify the likely cause, and open a pull request with a proposed fix.
update affected code, and open a pull request with the remediation.
Create automations and workflows that integrate with Slack, GitHub, Linear, and more.
Watch for a configurable label on pull requests, inspect full PR context, and post an AI review comment once per label event.
